## LLM005 block/collect in a streaming method

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | warning |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://pgy763.github.io/llm-dev-pitfalls/java/WebFlux里block流式结果 |
| Turn it off | `LLM005: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM005` on the command line |

Reactive streams must run on the event loop. block() pins the thread and Netty's few threads run out fast; the stream is already subscribed, so blocking will not give you the full result either.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM005` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm005 -->

## What it looks like

`.block()` or `.collectList().block()` on a reactive chain inside a method that returns `Flux` / `Mono`.

## How to fix

Return the chain as it is and let the framework subscribe. Blocking there parks the event loop thread and the client sees nothing until the end.
